cohort: The study included 17 fetuses diagnosed with oligohydramnios between 2004 and 2011.
finding: Survival of fetuses with oligohydramnios was significantly predicted by higher birth weight and a mean amniotic fluid index (AFI) greater than 1.0 cm.
birth_weight: Survivors had a mean birth weight of 2,457 ± 480 grams, while non-survivors had 1,973 ± 124 grams.
gest_age: Oligohydramnios was first diagnosed at 21.6 ± 4.2 weeks gestation.
